newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks retreat on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks retreat on profit-taking.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks fell Wednesday as investors took profits following the market's two consecutive sessions of record high closes.
Wall Street was also nervous about the continued rise in long-term bond interest rates.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended down 51.18 points at 6,549.48, one day after finishing above the 6,600 level for the first time. In the broader market, declining issues led advances by a small margin on active volume of 560 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
